gen-gf-revalia-gf-ubuntu-sans: Revalia's stroke is cut to one line width, like sign-shop vinyl. Ubuntu Sans, in sans-serif form, has big round eyes and tubular curves that let the heading's bold, widely spaced letters stand out without crowding it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-alexandria: Alexandria reads clean and spacious, its sans-serif letters opening wide at the terminals. Warnes brings the opposite energy, ink strokes of exactly uniform thickness that taper away before they touch, and that tension is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-devanagari: Expressive and bold, Warnes draws every stem, bowl and tail like rope. Anek Devanagari is a modern sans with distinctly open letter mouths and a generous middle zone, so paragraphs of it read smoothly beneath that stretched, spacious heading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Warnes draws horizontals and verticals as thick as rod stock, with stretched, spacious tracking. Anek Gurmukhi follows with big open counters and generous round curves, so a long passage of it reads cleanly and without strain.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-kannada: Blocky meets brushed. Warnes keeps one monoweight stroke with ink tips that taper out before touching, and Anek Kannada steps in with a high x-height and terminals that stop well short of the stem.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-malayalam: Warnes has crossbars as fat as the stems they join. Anek Malayalam sits beside it in sans-serif form, with hardly any gap between x-height and caps and curve tips that never touch, so the spaced-out heading gets a compact partner.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu is built around wide, lofty bowls and rounds that stay open like an unlatched hook. A longer stretch of it reads in an approachable, clean rhythm.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anuphan: Big, bold, and a bit theatrical: Warnes keeps a constant stroke from top to baseline with tapering ink ends. Warnes is for attention; Anuphan, with big round bowls and open curves, is for easy reading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-arimo: Straight-edged, constant strokes and stretched spacing give Warnes a bold, expressive look. Arimo handles the text underneath, its sans letters tall on the line and open at the rounded terminals.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-armata: Armata reads contemporary, its lowercase filling most of the letter height with spacious gaps between characters. And Warnes, with rounded-wire strokes and tapering ink ends, gives the pair its strongest quality: wiry, expressive heading energy against a body that stays out of its way.
